itemized.notes: 4-page filing (Carrie Dickson, Clerk, 10/31/2006 interim): p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 Schedule A, p4 Schedule B. Both schedules are on the county's own form and TYPED, not handwritten. The 'Complete Mailing Address' column is entirely EMPTY - the filer left it blank; this is a filer omission, NOT a county redaction, so donor_city/donor_state are blank on every row and no address ever existed to discard.
